description: Result of `grit serve --setup` and `grit serve add-user`: a new user.

admin.description: Whether the user is an admin (read and write on every repository).

database.description: The user database the user was added to.

password.description: The temporary password generated for the user, shown only once. Absent when the password was typed in.

temporary.description: Whether the user must choose a new password when they first sign in (true for a generated password).

title: ServeUserOutcome
